report.clinical_summary: Patient has been managing HIV with Tivicay and Descovy for two years. Recently experiencing worsening chronic fatigue, joint pain, concentration difficulties, plus new persistent headaches and diarrhea. Uncertain whether symptoms are medication-related or illness progression. Patient expresses frustration and feeling overwhelmed, with times of emotional distress. Believes medication has helped maintain stability but recognizes limits. Has concerns about long-term side effects and is considering dosage adjustment. Sees illness as part of identity and ongoing challenge. Acknowledges injection drug use as factor but uncertain about other causes.
